title: Tutor agent service on Cloud Run: ID-token auth, scoped tools, guardrails
area: ADK agents, FastAPI and Cloud Run
scenario: Kestrel's FastAPI tutor agent (ADK-style tools and callbacks, called by the Spring Boot API with a Google-signed ID token) trusts everything: no auth, the model can call a write tool, read any learner's progress, loop forever and tell a learner the quiz answer.
task: Verify the caller's ID token: RS256, audience, issuer, expiry, allowed service account (401 vs 403)
Offer and run only read tools; feed errors back; bind learner and course to the session
Bound the tool loop with a fallback reply
Before-model topic guard and after-model answer-leak guard
acceptance: Hidden tests for every bad-token case and the model never being reached
Write tool never executes; scoping and loop bound hold
Both guards behave and normal hints pass through
ANSWER.md maps the design onto ADK callbacks and tool filters
